description: E1 oracle capability-profiling anchor set v3 (two-pass extension of v2: (1) docking-power extension, 19 docking anchors over 14 independent protein targets — the Fig. 3d instrument; (2) Part-A extension with three admitted targets — FGF2 (10 binders), swine influenza H3N2 HA (4 binders + literature negative), IFN-gamma (6 binders + printed negative) — v2's six targets carried verbatim; SARS-CoV-2 RBD and HIV-1 RT FANA rejected at curation (sequence printability)
convention: DNA aptamers scored as RNA via T->U (same convention as known_aptamers.json/TBA).

rejected_candidates.SARS-CoV-2 spike RBD: only 2 single-sequence kd-binders (PB6, PB6a); di/trimer are multivalent scaffold constructs (avidity confound)
rejected_candidates.HIV-1 RT (Part A): only 1 sequence-verified binder (T1.1 via 1HVU SEQRES + Kensch 2000); 12.01/12.01-S/M302/RT1t49 sequences figure-only. Docking-only (1HVU)
rejected_candidates.Factor IXa (Part A): single aptamer family (9.3 lineage); 9.3/9.3t sequences figure-only. Docking-only (8EPK)
rejected_candidates.Tenascin-C: Hicke 2001 clone sequences + Kd all figure-only (Fig 5/10)
rejected_candidates.EGFR: E03/E04/E07 individual Kd figure-only (text range 2-3 nM); only CL4sc literature negative
rejected_candidates.Ang2 Seq2_12_35: Table 2 printout layout cannot be reconciled with Seq2 at constant length
rejected_candidates.Ang2 11-1 (full): variable region identical to the 11-1.41 truncate (Seq1) — not double-counted
rejected_candidates.SARS-CoV-2 RBD (Part A, second pass): Shekar 2025 Table 3 prints 5 BLI KD values but the sequences sit in an 83-sequence SI zip WITHOUT any printed mapping to the aptamer IDs (Table S1 enumerates per-variant subsets with restarting S.No; two orderings internally consistent) — sequence identity not assertion-verifiable. Survey verdict overturned at curation 2026-08-28.
rejected_candidates.HIV-1 RT FANA (Part A, second pass): Ferreira-Bravo 2015 Table 1 prints >=9 family Kd values but the sequences are figure-only (Fig 3A / SI Fig S1 images); PDF/SI bot-walled from this environment and a vision extraction misread the primer-flank regions against the paper's own text-printed template — no independent verification anchor. Survey verdict overturned at curation 2026-08-28.
rejected_candidates.Streptavidin (Part A): Ruigrok 2012 ChemBioChem table behind paywall — 5 aptamers 35-375 nM SPR asserted at abstract level only; unverifiable this pass.

known_limitations: PDGF-BB Kd gradient spans only 0.028-0.3 nM (1 order) — within-target ranking analysis is underpowered; Soontornworajit 2010 mutants (25/220 nM) excluded because sequences are figure-only (PIVOT §3.13 discipline).
Ahmad 2011 Kd values were measured on 100-mer constructs including primer arms; entries store the variable region only (PDGF-08 printed as 58 nt).
Thrombin series mixes Kd assay methods (filter binding / SPR / bead assay); within-target ranking treats Kd as ordinal only (Spearman), cross-method comparability caveat carried over from P2.
Docking power testable on Thrombin only (VEGF/PDGF-BB lack experimental complexes).

IL-17A: Apt21-2 Kd (48.5 pM SPR) is a transcribed citation (Nakamura 2012 review of paywalled Ishiguro 2011) and is excluded from ranking; the FP subset (n=6) is the ranking-eligible set. AptAF42/dope1 sequences are template-DERIVED (lengths asserted == text: 69/68 nt; the doped region prints as 31 nt vs '30' text). Parvez immobilization likely presented monomeric IL-17 (main-text caveat); target protein = UniProt Q16552 mature chain 24-155.

Ang2: same-assay SPR ranking subset spans only 101-139 nM (0.14 order) — ranking decorative, screening is the contribution. Cross-assay Kd spread is large (White filter 2.2-3.1 nM vs Cho array 20.5 nM vs Shakeran SPR ~100-200 nM) — itself an illustration of assay-dependence. Seq1 printed as 40 nt vs '41-nt' text registered.

SARS-CoV-2 N: negatives are ALL in silico (the Sc80 scrambled control sequence is not printed anywhere). Ranking-eligible subset = the 6 Ni-NTA-orientation BLI binders (span 3.02-22.2 nM, 0.87 order); streptavidin-orientation and full-length Kd are excluded from ranking (orientation uncertain). tNSP9/tNSP10 parent rows differ from their names (NSP7/NSP9) — paper-internal offset registered.

Docking anchors: 1HVU is 4.75 A (low resolution, registered); 8EPK is docking-only for FIXa (single aptamer family). Docking pass criterion applied over all 5 anchors with per-target breakdown (pre-registered).
Docking v3: 8ZBF and 9T74 have 'to be published' citations — provenance is the RCSB deposition; re-verify when papers appear.
5VOE is a desGla + S195A factor-Xa construct (registered); 11F7t FANA (CFL) residues map to C.
5HRT is mouse autotaxin (species caveat); aptamer is a DNA/2'-OMe chimera.
3UZT models only a 7-nt core of the C13.18 aptamer — minimal interface.
7ZQS and 9T74 are cryoEM anchors (2.54 / 3.46 A) — first non-X-ray members of the docking set.
DNA aptamers: residues renamed to RNA letters without adding O2' atoms — atom-level deoxyribose remains (the structure-level reading of the T->U convention).
1OOA holds two identical aptamer copies (C, D) — decoys perturb both as one rigid body.

FGF2: primary PDF bot-walled — sequences/Kd verified via the Ribocentre-aptamer transcription (printed twice on that page) + family-motif nesting assertions; biphasic binders store Kd1 (two-site fit).

Influenza H3N2 HA: selection strain A/swine/Minnesota/SG-00235/2007 is GISAID-restricted — protein surrogate = A/swine/Illinois/03040/2010(H3N2) full-length HA0 (95.1% aa identity to the MN/2008 partial; mature slice 17-549, C-terminal 17 aa absent from the record); aptamer-binding breadth across swine H3 lineages is the paper's own live-virus result.

IFN-gamma: the M-series is a single in-silico-mutant family of B1-4 (same-assay Octet ranking is within-family by construction); the printed negative mutant is docking-designed, not experimentally binding-tested; B1-4 Kd diverges across papers (Cao 2014: 74.5 nM vs Zhao 2022: 913.9 nM) — registered, ranking uses only Zhao's same-assay values.
HA and FGF2 negatives are partly in silico (fixed-seed randoms, seeds in entry references) — the SARS-CoV-2 N convention; literature negatives where printed (HA1c; IFN-gamma negative mutant).
